{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders and loyal customers
filtered_sales = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]

# Check the data type of 'revenue'
print(f"Data type of 'revenue': {filtered_sales['revenue'].dtype}")

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
filtered_sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered_sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any NaN values after conversion
print(f"Number of NaN values in 'revenue': {filtered_sales['revenue'].isna().sum()}")

# Compute the mean revenue, dropping NaNs
mean_revenue = filtered_sales['revenue'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
